build_reshape_module: build a Haiku Reshape module to reshape a tensor to a target output_shape while preserving batch dimensions
build_flatten_module: build a Haiku Flatten module to flatten all non-batch dimensions of a tensor into a single dimension
test_reshape_infer_shape: test the _infer_shape helper to verify it correctly replaces the -1 wildcard in an output shape vector
review_reshape_preserve_dims: review the Reshape class preserve_dims parameter to understand how leading or trailing dimensions are preserved during reshaping
refactor_flatten_negative_preserve_dims: refactor code using Flatten with negative preserve_dims to flatten trailing dimensions instead of leading ones
